five_second.sells: online art/drawing courses tied to mindfulness and manifesting (Neurographica, Zentangle-style pattern drawing)
five_second.for_whom: adults drawn to creative, spiritual/wellness-flavored art practices

features_used.moment: I opened the menu and tapped Courses, then scrolled through the tiles for the AM Method certifications, membership, 7 Chakras Drawing, Tangle with Ann/Zendala, and Spirals looking for prices to compare.
I scrolled down about five screens and found a clear, large price: $59.00, crossed out from $159.99, with a short bullet list of what's included.

features_used.feature: Tangle with Ann / Zendala Drawing Course product page
features_used.moment: This page went on for what felt like forever - teacher bio, what Zendala is, techniques, who it's for - before I finally hit the price at the very bottom: $99, was $159.

features_used.feature: currency toggle (Pay in US dollars / Pay in British pounds)
features_used.moment: On the Zendala page I noticed two separate price boxes, one in dollars and one in pounds, which was a nice touch but not something I needed.

features_looked_for_but_missing: prices shown right on the course catalog tiles instead of only after opening each page
a lesson-by-lesson curriculum list on the 7 Chakras page like the Zendala page had
a side-by-side comparison of the two similar drawing courses
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the price text on each course page, once I finally reached it, was big, bold, and easy to read even zoomed in - $59 vs $99, clearly different
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: no prices anywhere on the course catalog page, so comparing meant opening both course pages and scrolling through everything else first - one of the two pages was enormously long

friction.moment: The course catalog listed six course tiles with no price on any of them - I had to open each one individually just to find a number.
The Zendala/Tangle with Ann page went on for over 10,000 pixels of scrolling - teacher bio, techniques, who it's for - with the price buried at the very bottom, well past the 7 Chakras page's length.

I expected the two cheap drawing courses to cost the same like my errand assumed, but they didn't - $59 versus $99, a real $40 gap, and one is even taught by a different named teacher than the site owner.

delight.moment: The price numbers themselves, once I scrolled to them, were large and high-contrast - easy on my eyes without extra zooming.
The Zendala page had a 'Who This Course Is For' section that explicitly mentioned beginners, which made me feel like it was written for someone like me.

what_earned_it: clear before/after discount pricing shown on both course pages
a named real teacher with a bio and credentials for the Zendala course
transparent multi-currency pricing (US dollars and British pounds) shown side by side
trust.what_it_would_take: put prices on the catalog tiles up front and give both drawing courses the same depth of curriculum detail so I'm comparing like with like

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's a small artist's site with spiritual-style drawing courses - pretty pictures, but you have to scroll forever through each course page just to find out what it actually costs.
